name: Starship Odyssey
description: You command a deep-space explorer at the edge of known space. Walk the decks from the bridge to the warp core and see what the void has waiting.

player.name: Commander
player.description: A starship commander exploring the far reaches of known space

rooms.name: Command Bridge
rooms.description: The nerve center of the starship hums with activity. Holographic displays float above sleek control stations, showing star charts, system diagnostics, and sensor readings. The main viewscreen dominates the forward wall, currently displaying the swirling colors of a nearby nebula. Soft blue lighting illuminates the command chair at the center of the bridge. Doors lead aft to the corridor and forward to the observation deck.

fixtures.name: Command Console
fixtures.description: The captain's console displays ship-wide status, communications, and tactical information. Touch-sensitive controls respond to the slightest gesture, and a neural interface port allows direct connection to ship systems.

fixtures.name: Main Viewscreen
fixtures.description: A massive high-resolution display shows the space ahead of the ship. Advanced sensors can overlay tactical data, stellar cartography, or magnified views of distant objects.

rooms.name: Main Corridor
rooms.description: The ship's primary corridor stretches fore and aft, its walls lined with status panels and emergency equipment lockers. Soft lighting guides the way, and the gentle hum of the ship's engines vibrates through the deck plates. Crew members pass by on their duties. Doors lead forward to the bridge, down to engineering, and aft to the cargo bay.

fixtures.name: Ship Status Panel
fixtures.description: A wall-mounted display shows real-time status of all ship systems: life support, propulsion, shields, and weapons. Warning lights indicate any anomalies.

fixtures.name: Emergency Equipment Locker
fixtures.description: A sealed locker contains emergency supplies: EVA suits, medical kits, emergency rations, and portable oxygen generators.

rooms.name: Observation Deck
rooms.description: A transparent dome provides a breathtaking 360-degree view of space. Stars stretch to infinity in all directions, and the nearby nebula paints the void in shades of purple and gold. Comfortable seating allows crew members to contemplate the cosmos. A passage leads back to the bridge.

fixtures.name: Observation Telescope
fixtures.description: A powerful telescope can focus on distant stellar phenomena, alien vessels, or planetary surfaces. Its advanced optics can detect details across vast distances.

fixtures.name: Interactive Star Chart
fixtures.description: A holographic star chart displays known space, trade routes, and unexplored regions. It can be updated with new discoveries and plot courses to distant systems.

rooms.name: Engineering Bay
rooms.description: The heart of the ship pulses with barely contained energy. The warp core glows with blue-white light at the center of the chamber, surrounded by control stations and diagnostic equipment. Engineers monitor power distribution, propulsion systems, and life support. The air smells of ozone and lubricant. A ladder leads up to the main corridor.

fixtures.name: Warp Core
fixtures.description: The ship's primary power source and faster-than-light drive. Magnetic containment fields barely contain the matter-antimatter reaction that powers the vessel. Status indicators show power output and containment integrity.

fixtures.name: Engineering Station
fixtures.description: The chief engineer's console provides complete control over ship systems: propulsion, power distribution, shields, and environmental controls.

rooms.name: Cargo Bay
rooms.description: A cavernous space holds the ship's cargo, supplies, and equipment. Magnetic clamps secure containers to the deck, and a massive airlock dominates the outer wall. Loading equipment stands ready, and environmental suits hang in racks near the airlock. The corridor leads forward to the main ship.

fixtures.name: Cargo Containers
fixtures.description: Standardized shipping containers hold supplies, trade goods, and scientific equipment. Manifest displays show contents and destination.

fixtures.name: Cargo Airlock
fixtures.description: A large airlock allows cargo transfer and EVA operations. Safety interlocks prevent accidental decompression, and status lights show current pressure and seal integrity.

doors.name: Bridge Door
doors.description: A sliding door between the command bridge and the main corridor aft of it.

doors.name: Observation Passage
doors.description: A short passage running forward from the command bridge to the observation deck.

doors.name: Engineering Ladder
doors.description: A ladder between the main corridor and the engineering deck below.

doors.name: Cargo Bay Entrance
doors.description: The aft end of the main corridor, opening into the cargo bay.
